import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t, counter;
    static int[][] source_cap, sink_cap, source_num, sink_num;
    static int[][][] plant;
    static int[][] flo;
    static int[] dr = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dc = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static boolean is_valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
    }

    static int get_path() {
        int[] parent = new int[counter + 1];
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[0] = 0;
        Deque<Integer> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        stack.push(0);
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            int top = stack.pop();
            if (top == counter) break;
            for (int i = 0; i <= counter; ++i) {
                if (flo[top][i] > 0 && parent[i] == -1) {
                    parent[i] = top;
                    stack.push(i);
                }
            }
        }
        if (parent[counter] == -1) return 0;
        int ans = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        int pos = counter;
        while (pos != 0) {
            ans = Math.min(ans, flo[parent[pos]][pos]);
            pos = parent[pos];
        }
        pos = counter;
        while (pos != 0) {
            flo[parent[pos]][pos] -= ans;
            flo[pos][parent[pos]] += ans;
            pos = parent[pos];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        int maxNodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        flo = new int[maxNodes][maxNodes];
        char[][] first = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            first[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        source_cap = new int[n][n];
        sink_cap = new int[n][n];
        plant = new int[n][n][t + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = first[i][j];
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = c - 'X';
                    source_cap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    source_cap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        char[][] second = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            second[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = second[i][j];
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    plant[i][j][0] = c - 'X';
                    sink_cap[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                    sink_cap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        // propagate plant states
        for (int curr_time = 1; curr_time <= t; ++curr_time) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    plant[i][j][curr_time] = plant[i][j][curr_time - 1];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (plant[i][j][curr_time - 1] == 2) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int nr = i + dr[k];
                            int nc = j + dc[k];
                            if (is_valid(nr, nc) && plant[nr][nc][curr_time - 1] == 0) {
                                plant[nr][nc][curr_time] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // assign node numbers
        counter = 1;
        source_num = new int[n][n];
        sink_num = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (source_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    source_num[i][j] = counter;
                    counter++;
                } else {
                    source_num[i][j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    sink_num[i][j] = counter;
                    counter++;
                } else {
                    sink_num[i][j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }
        // BFS to connect source nodes to sink nodes
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (source_cap[i][j] == 0) continue;
                int srcNode = source_num[i][j];
                ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
                boolean[][] vis = new boolean[n][n];
                q.add(new int[]{0, i, j});
                vis[i][j] = true;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q.poll();
                    int curTime = cur[0];
                    int r = cur[1];
                    int c = cur[2];
                    if (sink_cap[r][c] != 0) {
                        int sinkNode = sink_num[r][c];
                        flo[srcNode][sinkNode] = 10000;
                    }
                    if (curTime == t) continue;
                    if (plant[r][c][curTime] != 0) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r + dr[k];
                        int nc = c + dc[k];
                        if (is_valid(nr, nc) && plant[nr][nc][curTime] == 0 && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                            q.add(new int[]{curTime + 1, nr, nc});
                            vis[nr][nc] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // set source and sink edges
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (source_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    flo[0][source_num[i][j]] = source_cap[i][j];
                }
                if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    flo[sink_num[i][j]][counter] = sink_cap[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        // max flow
        int ans = 0;
        while (true) {
            int temp = get_path();
            if (temp == 0) break;
            ans += temp;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
